::: {.home-intro}
# Pacific Spirit Trail Runners

A trail-running group in [Pacific Spirit Regional Park](https://metrovancouver.org/services/regional-parks/park/pacific-spirit-regional-park),
Vancouver. Our runs start and finish at the Park Centre, the ranger station
on Cleveland Trail at W 16th Ave.
